field_and_hypotheses: Every field; literal cyclic source A(a,b); 2<=r<min(a,b); polynomial source moments obeying f_(k+r)=xz*f_k with original bidegree bounds. The general primitive-degree-(1,1) chart is not covered.
prior_credit: The canonical cyclic source and coefficient formula are prior repository work. PR134 supplies the supporting-degree/additive-cost question and its r=n-1 two-variable family. Its exact-rank helper is reused for discovery; the new acceptance factorization uses separately generated literal source coefficients and identity minors.
local_continuation: Complete binomial-chart minimum, residue-key rectangles and exact basis ranks, all-polynomial-initial-moment weight degeneration, feasible/zero chart criterion, and balanced closed minimum.
external_dependencies: No new external theorem. Rank invariance under explicit diagonal scalings and rank nonincrease in a polynomial limit are proved directly with matrix entries and minors.
evidence_tiers: The all-parameter argument is written and unreviewed. Finite grids, literal identity minors and the original-source replay support indexing and implementation; they are not a proof of arbitrary other supporting forms. The sixteen-pivot discovery trial is not an exclusion.
